about_zh: 字体、图标、配色、设计系统这些视觉基础件。

repos.description: A collection of DESIGN.md files analysis by popular brand design systems. Drop one into your project and let coding agents generate a matching UI.
repos.summary_zh: 精选55+个知名网站的DESIGN.md设计系统文档，为AI编码代理提供纯文本规范以生成像素级完美UI。完整定义视觉主题、色彩、排版、组件样式及响应式行为，无需Figma或JSON等复杂工具，显著提升AI驱动前端开发的效率与一致性。
repos.summary_en: A curated collection of 55+ DESIGN.md files from popular websites, capturing complete design systems in plain text. Enables AI coding agents to generate pixel-perfect UIs by defining visual themes, colors, typography, components, and responsive behavior. Eliminates Figma exports or JSON schemas, streamlining AI-powered frontend development with LLM-friendly markdown format.

repos.description: An ultra-simplified explanation to design patterns
repos.summary_zh: 本项目以极简方式解释软件设计模式，涵盖创建型、结构型、行为型三大类23种模式。通过生活化类比和PHP代码示例，将抽象概念具象化，帮助开发者快速理解并应用。核心价值在于降低学习门槛，提供实用指南而非理论堆砌，适合编程初学者和需要复习的开发者。
repos.summary_en: This project delivers ultra-simplified explanations of software design patterns, encompassing 23 fundamental patterns across creational, structural, and behavioral categories. Through intuitive real-world analogies and practical PHP code samples, it demystifies abstract concepts and makes them stick. The repository serves as an accessible learning resource that emphasizes practical application over theoretical complexity. Designed for programming beginners and experienced developers seeking quick reference, it provides clear guidelines for tackling recurring software design problems effectively.

repos.description: Maple Mono: Open source monospace font with round corner, ligatures and Nerd-Font icons for IDE and terminal, fine-grained customization options. 带连字和控制台图标的圆角等宽字体，中英文宽度完美2:1，细粒度的自定义选项
repos.summary_zh: Maple Mono 是一款开源等宽字体，专为提升代码阅读体验设计。核心亮点包括圆角美学、智能连字和完整的 Nerd-Font 图标支持。其独特的中英文 2:1 宽度对齐技术，在多语言混排和 Markdown 表格中实现完美视觉对齐。V7 版本采用可变字体技术，支持无级字重调节和细粒度特性控制，适配各类 IDE 和终端环境。
repos.summary_en: Maple Mono is an open-source monospace font designed to enhance coding workflow. Key features include rounded corners, smart ligatures, and comprehensive Nerd-Font icon integration. Its unique 2:1 Chinese-English width alignment ensures perfect visual harmony in multilingual code and Markdown tables. The V7 remake introduces variable font technology with infinite weight control and granular customization options, optimized for IDEs and terminals.

repos.description: A free + OSS logo generator powered by Flux on Together AI
repos.summary_zh: 开源免费的AI标志生成器，基于Together AI上的FLUX.2 pro与FLUX.1 Kontext，几秒内生成品牌级Logo并导出完整品牌套件。无需账号即可使用，支持参考图上传、多风格与SVG导出。采用Next.js + TypeScript构建，UI基于Radix与Tailwind，可选Clerk认证与Upstash限流，适合设计师与创业者快速创建专业视觉标识。
repos.summary_en: Free open-source AI logo generator powered by FLUX.2 pro and FLUX.1 Kontext on Together AI. Creates brand-ready logos in seconds and exports a full brand kit, fully account-less. Supports reference image upload, multiple styles and SVG export. Built with Next.js + TypeScript, Radix + Tailwind UI, optional Clerk auth and Upstash rate limiting. Ideal for designers and founders needing professional visual identity fast.

repos.summary_zh: op7418/logo-generator-skill 是一个专业的SVG Logo生成技能，集成Gemini大模型快速生成6+种设计变体，并利用图像预览功能创建12种专业背景的展示图像。核心价值在于融合经典设计原则（极致简约、留白、精准比例）与AI技术，产出高质量、可编辑的SVG和PNG格式Logo，解决传统设计耗时与AI输出粗糙的痛点。适用于初创公司、开发者、设计师快速获取专业品牌标识，支持交互式HTML预览与迭代优化。
repos.summary_en: The logo-generator-skill repository delivers a professional SVG logo generation skill powered by Gemini AI. It produces 6+ distinct design variants based on product characteristics and proven principles like extreme simplicity and negative space, then generates high-end showcase images with 12 curated professional backgrounds using Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview. Outputs include editable SVGs, PNG exports, and interactive HTML previews. Ideal for startups, developers, designers, and product teams needing fast, production-ready logo solutions and presentations.

repos.description: Javascript library for generating identicons. Running in the browser and on Node.js.
repos.summary_zh: Jdenticon 是一个轻量级 JavaScript 库，用于生成高识别度的 identicon 头像。它支持 SVG 和 Canvas 渲染，可在浏览器和 Node.js 环境中运行。通过确定性哈希算法，相同输入始终生成一致的视觉图标，完美适合作为用户头像占位符。库体积小巧，零依赖，并提供 React、Angular 等主流框架的集成方案，是构建用户标识系统的理想选择。
repos.summary_en: Jdenticon is a lightweight JavaScript library for generating highly recognizable identicon avatars. Supporting both SVG and Canvas rendering, it runs in browsers and Node.js. Using deterministic hash algorithms, identical inputs always produce consistent visual icons, making it perfect for user avatar placeholders. With minimal bundle size, zero dependencies, and official integrations for React, Angular, and other frameworks, it's an ideal solution for user identification systems.

repos.description: 划时代的字体切割工具，CJK与任何字符！支持 otf、ttf、woff2 字体多线程切割，完美地细颗粒度地进行包大小控制。A revolutionary font subetter that supports CJK and any characters! It enables multi-threaded subset of otf, ttf, and woff2 fonts, allowing for precise control over package size.
repos.summary_zh: cn-font-split 是专为Web场景打造的字体子集化工具，通过Rust核心与WebAssembly技术实现秒级切割。针对中文等CJK字符集大包体积痛点，提供细粒度字符拆分与多线程处理，支持OTF/TTF/WOFF2格式及可变字体。跨平台一致性输出，集成Vite等前端工具链，显著优化网页字体加载性能。
repos.summary_en: cn-font-split is a revolutionary font subsetting engine designed for web font optimization, particularly for massive CJK character sets. Built with Rust and WebAssembly, it enables fine-grained character-level splitting with multi-threaded processing, achieving 50ms latency for 2MB fonts. Supporting OTF/TTF/WOFF2 formats, variable fonts, and complex glyph rendering via Harfbuzz integration, it delivers consistent outputs across browsers, Node.js, Deno, Bun, and native platforms. The tool integrates seamlessly with Vite, Webpack, and other frontend toolchains, eliminating render-blocking font loading while reducing bundle sizes by up to 90% and supporting 95+ OpenType features.

repos.description: 开源的中国传统纹样图录项目 · 100 高清纹样(规划 800) · 中英日韩双语 · CC BY-NC 4.0 · https://wenyang.net
repos.summary_zh: 开源的中国传统纹样图鉴项目，收录100张高清原创PNG卡片图（规划800张），分为植物花卉、动物瑞兽、几何锦纹等六大类。每张配中英日韩双语名称、简介、文化寓意、视觉关键词及详细资料页，提供patterns.json与patterns.csv结构化数据集。配套静态网站wenyang.net支持浏览、检索、收藏与下载，采用CC BY-NC 4.0许可。核心价值是美术馆级审美与开放获取，服务设计师与文化爱好者的非商业创作、研究与教育。
repos.summary_en: Open-source Chinese traditional patterns catalog with 100 high-res original PNG cards (planning 800), organized into six categories: flora, fauna, geometric, cloud-water-stone, auspicious objects, and characters. Each includes bilingual names, summaries, cultural meanings, keywords, and detailed pages, plus structured JSON/CSV datasets. Companion static site wenyang.net enables browsing, search, collection, and download under CC BY-NC 4.0. Emphasizes museum-quality aesthetics for non-commercial design, research, and cultural education.
